name: 白羽の城跡

placement.note: Stands on a 1.28 m plinth; placed 1.28 m below the terrain so the forecourt meets the valley floor.

notes: Rebuilt 2026-09-12 as a ruin: a broad open forecourt behind a collapsed gate, three very wide gentle stairs (left, centre, right) and one enormous roofless great hall on top where the sorcerer is fought. Full mesh shared; the coarse LODs are not adopted.

provenance.provider: Codex CLI image_gen reference (gpt-5.6-sol, medium) and local TRELLIS-2; reduction, walk atlas and integration by Claude Code
provenance.referencePrompt: Broad two-storey ruined limestone castle: open forecourt behind a collapsed arch gate, three very wide gentle stairs (left, centre, right) rising to one enormous roofless great hall with broken half-height walls and column stumps. User request 2026-09-12: rebuild the sorcerer's castle as a wide, easily climbed ruin whose top is a huge open-air hall where the sorcerer is fought. Candidate 01 of two Codex image_gen references selected by Claude Code (user not available); candidate 02 retained as history.
provenance.reconstruction: Local TRELLIS-2 1024 seed 42 (reference v3); shape-preserving quadric reduction at p95 0.03 m to 79594 triangles with the source UV and albedo.

review.notes: Seven software views of every triangle reviewed: a broad two-storey ruin with a collapsed arch gate in the front wall, an open forecourt, three wide straight stairs and one roofless great hall with column stumps and broken half-height walls. The walk atlas shows the forecourt, all three stairs and the whole hall as one connected floor.
